sonuc.drug_name: Rasilez 150 mg film-coated tablets / Rasilez 300 mg film-coated tablets

what_for.text: This medicine helps to lower high blood pressure in adult patients.
what_for.evidence: This helps to lower high blood pressure in adult patients.

how_to_use.text: Swallow the tablet whole with some water.
how_to_use.evidence: Swallow the tablet whole with some water.

how_to_use.text: Take once a day, always with or always without food, at the same time.
how_to_use.evidence: You should take this medicine once a day, always with or always without food, preferably at the same time each day.

how_to_use.text: Avoid taking this medicine with fruit juice or drinks containing plant extracts.
how_to_use.evidence: You should avoid taking this medicine together with fruit juice and/or drinks containing plant extracts (including herbal teas).

how_to_use.text: If you forget a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
how_to_use.evidence: If you forget to take a dose of this medicine, take it as soon as you remember and then take the next dose at its usual time.

how_to_use.text: Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten dose.
how_to_use.evidence: Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten dose.

see_doctor_now.text: If you get swelling of the face, breathing difficulty, or rash, tell your doctor straight away.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Some side effects can be serious (frequency not known): ... If any of the following occur, tell your doctor straight away: ... Severe allergic reaction with symptoms such as rash, itching, swelling of face or lips or tongue, difficulty breathing, dizziness.

see_doctor_now.text: If you experience angioedema or swelling of face, hands, or feet, stop taking it and contact your doctor.
see_doctor_now.evidence: if you have already experienced angioedema (difficulties in breathing or swallowing, or swelling of the face, hands and feet, eyes, lips and/or tongue). If this happens, stop taking this medicine and contact your doctor.

see_doctor_now.text: If you have severe and persistent diarrhoea, you should stop taking Rasilez.
see_doctor_now.evidence: If you have severe and persistent diarrhoea you should stop taking Rasilez.

see_doctor_now.text: If you accidentally take too many tablets, consult a doctor immediately.
see_doctor_now.evidence: If you have accidentally taken too many tablets of this medicine, consult a doctor immediately.

side_effects.text: Common side effects include diarrhoea, joint pain, high potassium levels, and dizziness.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people): Diarrhoea, joint pain (arthralgia), high level of potassium in the blood, dizziness.

side_effects.text: Uncommon side effects include skin rash, kidney problems, low blood pressure, and swelling.
side_effects.evidence: Uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people): Skin rash ... kidney problems ... swelling of hands, ankles or feet ... low blood pressure

storage.text: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
storage.evidence: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.

storage.text: Store in the original package in order to protect from moisture.
storage.evidence: Store in the original package in order to protect from moisture.
